title: I made a Suika-style merge game with 11 original Indian characters, using AI for art, music and code
author: Purple_Bathroom
selftext:
I run a small tech company in India and wanted to see how far AI could take a real mobile game, from idea to Play Store. The result is Golu Gang: Merge Drop. You drop little buddies into a jar, and two of the same merge into the next one.

**Art:** AI images in an Indian street-art style (flat vector, bold outlines). Used ElevenLabs and Canva.

**Music:** An Indian fusion theme (tabla, bansuri, sitar) made with ElevenLabs.

**Code:** Written mostly with Claude.

Self promo, if you want to try it [Try on Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.utsltech.mergedrop&referrer=utm_source%3Dreddit%26utm_medium%3Dpost%26utm_campaign%3Daigamedev) 

Feedback and suggestion are welcome.
